extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved cetuximab (14 days) in combination with irinotecan (14 days) for reimbursement as a treatment option for the second-line treatment of patients with RAS wild type metastatic colorectal cancer after failure of or contraindication to oxaliplatin based therapy. The European Medicine Agency's product information for Erbitux (cetuximab) defines RAS wild type as considering mutational status of KRAS and NRAS exons 2, 3, and 4, and that mutational status should be determined by an experienced laboratory using validated test methods.
